Name: Pam's Recolored Buildings Add-Ons

Description:
This mod aims to add the missing replacement files for Develsaa's Re-colored Buildings found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/98 based on re-coloring vanilla Stardew buildings to hopefully match Develsaa's color palette.  

Currently adds

[b]Sheds[/b]
[left]﻿[/left][list]

[/list]

I will hopefully be adding other colors and maybe buildings as time permits but as I work on Pam's HarvestCraft for Minecraft, my time is limited.  Hopefully folks understand!  

Thanks!
